_comment: Two trinket slots per hero. rarity: common / uncommon / rare / boss. price is used by the General Store. class: optional class restriction.

lucky_horseshoe.name: Lucky Horseshoe
lucky_horseshoe.desc: Bent iron, nailed over a hundred doors.

silver_spurs.name: Silver Spurs
silver_spurs.desc: They jingle when you walk. Everybody hears you coming.

pocket_bible.name: Pocket Bible
pocket_bible.desc: Stopped a bullet once. Or so they say.

wolf_tooth.name: Wolf-Tooth Necklace
wolf_tooth.desc: Taken from a wolf that picked the wrong camp.

salt_charm.name: Salt-Charm Pouch
salt_charm.desc: Old country wisdom for new country monsters.

tin_canteen.name: Dented Canteen
tin_canteen.desc: Always seems to have one more swallow.

iron_gorget.name: Iron Gorget
iron_gorget.desc: Old cavalry armor for the throat.

loaded_dice.name: Loaded Dice
loaded_dice.desc: They always come up sevens. Almost always.

miners_lamp.name: Old Jeb's Lamp
miners_lamp.desc: It never quite goes out, even with no oil in it.

crow_feather_charm.name: Blackwing Feather
crow_feather_charm.desc: Ruby wore it in her hat. The crows still nod at it.

stagecoach_ticket.name: Unused Stage Ticket
stagecoach_ticket.desc: A way home, never used. Yet.

cranes_revolver.name: Crane's Engraved Revolver
cranes_revolver.desc: Silas Crane's pride and joy. The grip still has his initials.

cyclops_eye_stone.name: Cyclops' Eye-Stone
cyclops_eye_stone.desc: A pupil-sized agate that never stops watching.

titan_shard.name: Shard of the Titan
titan_shard.desc: Warm to the touch, and very heavy.
